material.execution: Materialize the nine jobs in the existing batch format. Each replicate contains base, geometry and frame, with order rotated. Every successor is judged joined directly to the same predecessor; no intervening art scene. Preserve originals and every receipt. Generate only when this study is requested for execution.

evaluation.judgmentProtocol: Hide condition names and prompts; rotate left/right presentation. For each matched pair, record left, right or indistinguishable for continuity of the direct seam, and separately record each objective requirement violation. Reveal condition labels only after all verdicts are frozen.
evaluation.decisionRule: For each comparison, three wins out of three with no objective requirement violation supports only that local pilot; two wins or any tie is inconclusive; zero or one win is no demonstrated advantage. Report geometry-versus-base and geometry-versus-frame separately. Do not claim equivalence from a tie or superiority from generation success.
